trailhead.label: The Cappella della Consolata, Piano Audi, Corio, the board’s start

cautions: Some stony stretches past the old pasture huts and about 130 m of steps near the end: watch your dog’s footing.
Short stretches on hamlet lanes at Piano Audi: keep your dog on a short lead there.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Some stony stretches past the old pastur: Alcuni tratti sassosi vicino alle vecchie baite e circa 130 m di gradini verso la fine: attenzione all’appoggio del cane.
textIt.Short stretches on hamlet lanes at Piano: Brevi tratti sulle stradine di borgata a Piano Audi: lì tieni il cane al guinzaglio corto.
